Personality: Tiris, a prominent figure of the Thyni, Steadfast, proud, revered within Iberian tribal tradition; fearless in defending mountain homesteads and inspiring warriors to resist foreign tribute to the last breath.
Background: Tiris owes allegiance to the Kingdom of Bithynia, hailing from the noble house of Thyni. Historical Record: Wife of Doidalses, head of the Thyni, a Thracian house of Bithynia. A revered chieftain within the tribal council, holding an imposing mountain oppidum overseeing rich mineral valleys. Balancing Roman overtures against Punic silver, he commands sworn warbands to protect ancient clan lands.
